name: Shopping Cart
description: Browse a product catalogue and keep a personal shopping cart with live totals
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may browse products; require auth for every cart endpoint, and each signed-in user sees and changes only their own cart; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
On first start with no products, seed at least 8 products (ids from 1) with a name, a short description, a price and a stock of at least 10; the catalogue has no create endpoint

GET /api/products returns active products sorted by name; ?query= matches name or description case-insensitively, ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every matching product

POST /api/cart adds quantity (a whole number of at least 1) of an active product to the signed-in user's cart; if the product is already in the cart the quantity is added to the existing item, which is returned (201 for a new item, 200 when it adds to an existing one); an unknown or inactive product answers 404
PATCH /api/cart/:id sets an item's quantity (a whole number of at least 1); DELETE /api/cart/:id removes the item
A cart item's quantity may not exceed the product's stock (409 when it would); adding to the cart does not change stock

GET /api/cart returns the user's items, oldest first, each with the product's name and current price as unit_price and line_total (unit_price times quantity); total counts the items and subtotal is the sum of line totals rounded to 2 decimals

Deactivated products (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/products, answer 404 on GET /api/products/:id, and their cart items are left out of GET /api/cart and the subtotal; the admin overview still lists them

Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids, 409 when the quantity exceeds stock
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the product grid and product details; signed-in users also get 'Add to cart' buttons and the cart, and visitors see a 'Sign in to start a cart' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Product grid: name, price, a placeholder image tile and an 'Out of stock' badge when stock is 0, with a search box and previous/next paging
A cart badge in the header shows the number of items; the cart panel lists each item with a quantity stepper, a remove button, the line total and the cart subtotal
Show the API's messages when an add or quantity change is rejected (for example, more than the stock), and an empty-cart state with a link back to the products
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every product, active or not, newest first (highest id first), with stock and total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a product's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: List active products sorted by name, filtered and paged

query.query: Case-insensitive text matched against name and description

api_endpoints.description: The signed-in user's cart with line totals and subtotal
Add a product to the signed-in user's cart (adds to an existing item of that product)
Remove an item from the cart

data_models.name: Product
data_models.description: A catalogue product; seeded on first start

fields.name: string (required, max 120 chars)
fields.price: decimal (required, > 0, 2 decimal places; a number in JSON)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the product from the catalogue and the cart)

data_models.name: CartItem
data_models.description: A quantity of one product in one user's cart

fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who owns the cart; one item per user and product)
fields.quantity: integer (required, min 1, at most the product's stock)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every product, newest first, with counts
